messages.content: User task: Set up a humane trap to catch the mouse in the kitchen

raw_response:
To humanely catch a mouse in your kitchen, use a live-catch trap (like a Havahart or similar box trap) baited with peanut butter, chocolate, or seeds. Place it along walls where you've seen droppings, check it every few hours, and release any captured mouse at least 100 yards away in a wooded area. Seal entry points afterward with steel wool and caulk.

PLAN: Purchase a live-catch mouse trap
PLAN: Bait trap with peanut butter or sunflower seeds
PLAN: Place trap along kitchen baseboards near droppings
PLAN: Check trap every 2–3 hours
PLAN: Release captured mouse far from home
PLAN: Seal mouse entry holes with steel wool and caulk
